text:
Lena R: quick q — for dataset row delete, do we show Undo inline or use a toast? sketch: https://redwood.design/undo-row-sketch :paperclip:
Tom B: inline feels more discoverable in a table. single-word `Undo` keeps density low.
Priya S: agree inline for single deletes. tooltip should explain timeframe. current products use 30s elsewhere so keep consistent.
Tom B: suggested tooltip copy: "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds."
Lena R: good point on consistency. i worry about screen readers not seeing the tooltip. we need an aria-label and an announcement.
Priya S: aria suggestions: `aria-live="polite"` when action happens; and add `aria-label="Undo deletion of Metrics.csv. Restores for 30 seconds."` on the link. also ensure tooltip is shown on focus.
Design Bot: accessibility checklist: 1) announce deletion via aria-live polite with item name and undo window 2) inline link must be keyboard-focusable 3) tooltip content exposed on focus (not only hover) 4) provide clear aria-label on the Undo control 5) ensure color contrast for link/focus is >= 3:1
Tom B: one-line inline copy = `Undo`. tooltip sentence-case: "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds." keyboard state shows same tooltip.
Lena R: decision: inline single-word `Undo` + tooltip "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds." + aria-label example and aria-live announcement. I'll add details to the PR. approvals?
Tom B: approved. :white_check_mark:
Priya S: approved, add keyboard snippet in PR and example aria-live payload.
Design Bot: recorded: microcopy decision saved to design notes.
